_note: Godot-only display text for the setup wizard (ui/setup_wizard.gd): the game type sections, each mode's short card line (2 lines at most, never truncated), a colour accent and a drawn icon kind (SetupWizard.ModeIcon). `long` replaces the web `desc` in the detail line under the grid where that is too long for 2 lines. shared/*.json stays as exported from the web game. A mode missing here falls back to its desc and the Special section.

deathmatch.short: Free for all. First to 20 K.O.s

sudden.short: One life each. Last one standing

duel.short: You vs one bot. First to 5

t2.short: 2 vs 2. Team score, no friendly fire

t4.short: Big team fight. First team to 20

lowg.short: Super low gravity. Float and soar

pillars.short: Start on pillars. A new weapon every 10 s
pillars.long: Start on tall pillars too far apart to jump (dash with any weapon!). A new weapon every 10 seconds. Fall or die and you are out. Most K.O.s after 3 minutes wins.

construction.short: Tradies, hammers, live wire, air blowers

practice.short: Dummies and a rack of weapons. No score

sandbox.short: Build an arena with blocks, then play it
